entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: An embattled world of ambitious warlords and powerful clans waging eternal war for supremacy, home plane of Sarkhan Vol, once inhabited by dragons.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker whose home plane is Tarkir.

entities.name: Dragons of Tarkir
entities.description: The dragons that once inhabited Tarkir, all killed long before Sarkhan's time; each clan worships one aspect of them.

entities.name: Clans of Tarkir
entities.description: The powerful clans of Tarkir, each worshipping one aspect of the extinct dragons.

events.summary: The clans of Tarkir wage a conflict for supremacy over the plane that spans a thousand years.
events.quote: Tarkir is an embattled world of ambitious warlords and powerful clans that wage eternal war for supremacy over their plane in a conflict that spans a thousand years.

events.summary: Dragons, which once inhabited Tarkir, were all killed long before Sarkhan's time.
events.quote: all of whom were killed long before Sarkhan's time

relations.note: each clan worships one aspect of the extinct dragons
relations.quote: The clans each worship one aspect of the extinct dragons.
Tarkir is also the home plane of Sarkhan Vol .
